name: HealthBridge Clinic
roles: Clinical operations; reference reads; documented clinical deletes and backup operations.
SELECT approved clinical/reporting tables; staff password hashes withheld.
Local maintenance role; no role/database creation or schema CREATE.
query: SELECT a.appointment_id,a.appointment_date,a.status,a.reason,p.patient_id,p.first_name AS patient_first,p.last_name AS patient_last,p.contact_number,d.doctor_id,d.first_name AS doctor_first,d.last_name AS doctor_last,sp.specialty_name FROM public.appointments a JOIN public.patients p ON p.patient_id=a.patient_id JOIN public.doctors d ON d.doctor_id=a.doctor_id LEFT JOIN public.specialties sp ON sp.specialty_id=d.specialty_id ORDER BY a.appointment_date;

name: SHIORI Cafe
roles: Table CRUD and sequence USAGE; no schema/role/database creation.
Approved category/menu/table/payment reporting; no staff password-hash access.
query: SELECT r.table_id,r.reservation_start_at,r.reservation_end_at,c.full_name AS guest_name FROM shioricafe_schema.reservation r LEFT JOIN shioricafe_schema.customer c ON r.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE r.status='Confirmed' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP>=r.reservation_start_at AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP<r.reservation_end_at;

name: ByaheRentals / Car Rental
roles: SIU operational tables; DELETE vehicle only; audit UPDATE/DELETE denied.
Approved reporting columns; customer/staff password hashes withheld.
query: SELECT v.vehicle_id,v.make,v.model,v.year,c.category_name,v.seating_capacity,v.fuel_type,v.color,v.status,(SELECT r.rate_amount FROM public.rental_rate r WHERE r.category_id=v.category_id AND r.rental_period_type='Daily' AND r.rate_status='Active' ORDER BY r.rate_id LIMIT 1)+v.unit_rate_adjustment AS daily_rate FROM public.vehicle v JOIN public.vehicle_category c ON c.category_id=v.category_id WHERE c.category_status='Active' AND v.status<>'Retired' ORDER BY c.category_name,v.make,v.model;
